answer_1.quote: In this paper, we seek to understand and improve the ability of image generation models to render high-quality visual text.
answer_1.outputs: Images containing rendered visual text based on textual prompts

answer_2.quote: For OCR evaluation, we use the Google Cloud Vision API, which returns all text found within an image, along with bounding box locations.

answer_4.quote: We ask human raters to compare two models' generations of 8 images each across 200 prompts covering 11 thematic categories.
answer_4.guideline: Which set of images more accurately shows the text: "<target text>"?
